meaning:
δώρημα, -τος, τό
(δωρέω), [in LXX: Sir.31:18 (Sir.34:18)* ;]
a gift, boon: Rom.5:16, Jas.1:17.†
SYN.: see: δόμα (AS)

elsewhere.note: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
